page.overview:
What is Driftveil City?

Driftveil City is a historic port city in western Unova. It's connected to Nimbasa City in the east by Driftveil Drawbridge, which is operated by Clay, the -type expert and Driftveil City Gym Leader. To the west, it leads to Route 6. The area has a fairly cool climate, and is prone to rain all year round.

The city's Gym specializes in mining precious gemstones, and the city itself has a proud history of overseas trade, exporting various goods across the world. A lighthouse helps ships navigate the shoreline to safely arrive at the port and docking yard to the south, where containers are stored in dedicated cold storage facilities. The gold statue of a sail, located in the eastern entrance, symbolises just how important shipping is to the city.

Upon arriving here, the player character will come across Cheren and an angry Clay. Clay isn't happy that lowering the Driftveil Drawbridge has led to Team Plasma's escape; blaming the player character, he insists they hunt in Cold Storage for them, and won't battle until Team Plasma is ousted from the city.

After winning the Quake Badge, the player character will bump into Bianca when heading to Route 6. She gives HM02 Fly upon her defeat.
